`vrm` provides a unified toolkit for Bayesian and frequentist regression
workflows in R, wrapping [`brms`](https://paulbuerkner.com/brms/) for ordinal,
linear, logit, and nominal models with consistent interfaces for posterior
prediction, marginal effects, counterfactual analysis, propensity-score
weighting, data recoding, and publication-quality visualization.

## Install

```r
# From GitHub
devtools::install_github("crweber9874/vrm")
```

## Quick start

```r
library(vrm)

# Fit a Bayesian ordinal model
fit <- brms.ordinal(dv = "y", iv = "x * group", data = mydata, cores = 4)

# Posterior predicted means with an interaction
preds <- posterior_means(fit, iv_name = "x", moderator = "group", data = mydata)
```
